_what: Pinned expected values for r4-adjudicate.mjs (aggregator lane, round 10). Read-only for the gate: r4-adjudicate.mjs only READS this file. Three pinned groups: selftest.cases[] (isolated fixture expectations), frozen[] (per-class tallies at the eight committed frozen revisions, in SNAPSHOT mode so they re-derive), capture (one committed gate stdout with its `# json` line, which is what makes --from-json reproducible).

_provenance.upstream: node .ufo/waves/round-9/corpus-gate.mjs (frozen round-9 evidence; sha256 68939d0c70b6dc5ee9e2667b..., never edited by this round) supplies the r4 finding set; this gate only partitions it
_provenance.author: ExecR4Adjudicator seat, aggregator round-10 wave
_provenance.selftest_cases: fixtures are built by r4-adjudicate.mjs under os.tmpdir(); the expectations below were authored with the fixtures BEFORE the first --selftest run (as the round-9 gate's expected file declares for its own cases) and reconciled once against it
_provenance.selftest_independence: the fixture finding sets are injected into a synthesized gate-json line, and the selftest validates each injected file:line against the fixture bytes (line exists, carries no backtick, re-matches COUNT_NOUN_RE) before classifying; the two fixtures that inject an explicit excerpt (fx-line-unresolved, fx-line-mismatch) exercise the unresolvable/stale guards by construction and are marked as not byte-validated in the run's own `# fixture-note`
_provenance.frozen: each key is a committed round-9 frozen revision; the gate is re-spawned as `--snapshot <repo> <commit> --round 9 --json` (read-only, extracts into the gate's own os.tmpdir tree and removes it) and the per-class tallies below are compared against that run. The tallies were populated from THIS seat's first verified --frozen-all run and then re-run to confirm (a pin this seat measured itself is still a pin; the instant is named in the seat file .ufo/waves/round-10/seats/executor-adjudicator.md).
_provenance.frozen_cross_check: each frozen key is additionally cross-checked against the round-9 gate's own committed expected file (.ufo/waves/round-9/corpus-gate.expected.json frozen[key].stats.r4 and the count of CR-<repo>-r4-* ids in frozen[key].expect_findings); a disagreement is could-not-evaluate (exit 2), not drift, because it means the finding set itself did not reproduce
_provenance.capture: verbatim stdout of the frozen gate in --snapshot mode for one revision, committed so `--from-json` replays byte-exactly (snapshot revisions are read with `git show <commit>:corpus/<path>`, not from a moving worktree)
_provenance.verdict_shape: exit=1 means at least one r4 finding is a surviving `violation` (a measured count with no backticked command); it is NOT an error of this gate. exit=0 means every r4 finding is a classified false positive or is undecided.
